title: v2.1.128 Release
description: Latest Claude Code release with random session colors, MCP tool counts, plugin zip support, console channels for API key auth, model picker cleanup, OTEL isolation improvements, and numerous bug fixes.

community_feedback.quote: I use Claude Code for work every day. Honestly, after seeing the v2.1.128 update yesterday, I got chills. Not because the update was flashy, but because all three bugs it fixed were ones I encountered personally.

title: Week 19 Updates: Plugin System Enhancements & Command History
description: Load plugins from .zip archives and URLs, expanded plugin directory support, global command history search across projects using Ctrl+R, and Git worktree support with branch creation from local repositories.

title: PR Review, Build Plan in Parallel, and Split PRs
description: New PR review experience with inline review threads, commits tab, and changes tab. Build in parallel from plans using async subagents. Split changes into PRs with quick action. Pin skills as quick actions. Context usage breakdown.

community_feedback.quote: Reports of teams reducing code review time from 45 minutes to 10 minutes using Cursor's AI review commands.
Multiple reports about Cursor having too many bugs. Performance issues with large codebases (can be slow or freeze).

title: Model Controls, Spend Management, and Usage Analytics
description: Enterprise admins get model access controls with granular allow/blocklists, soft spend limits with intelligent alerts, updated usage analytics tab filtering, and team marketplace updates.

title: Cursor Security Review Beta
description: Cursor Security Review now in beta on Teams and Enterprise plans with Security Reviewer (checks PRs for vulnerabilities) and Vulnerability Scanner (scheduled scans of codebase). Customizable security agents.

title: Aider v0.56.0
description: Enables prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter, 8k output tokens for Sonnet via VertexAI and DeepSeek V2.5, new /report command for GitHub Issues, --chat-language switch, and numerous bug fixes.

community_feedback.quote: There's a GitHub issue (#1507) about Windows installation difficulties with Aider v0.56.0

title: May 2026 Updates: Copilot Code Review, CLI Improvements, and Security Features
description: Copilot code review comment types now in usage metrics API. Rubber Duck in GitHub Copilot CLI now supports more models. Enterprise-managed plugins in GitHub Copilot CLI are now in public preview. Secret scanning and dependency scanning with GitHub MCP Server. CodeQL 2.25.3 adds Swift 6.3 support.

title: Model Deprecations - May 2026
description: Upcoming deprecation of Grok Code Fast 1, GPT-4.1, and Claude Sonnet 4. Deprecation notice for GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.2-Codex.

title: Shareable Agents and Code Review Inbox
description: You can now generate publicly shareable links to your agents so that others can try out your workflows. Continue's pull request inbox helps you ship code faster and with higher quality. You can filter by pull requests you've opened or that are assigned to you.

title: v2.1.126 Release - Project Purge & Enhanced Features
description: Added project purge command, broader skip-permissions, pasteable OAuth codes, skill activation telemetry, gateway model picker, Windows PowerShell detection, and security fixes.
